summary: The empty-state copy was updated honestly to match the widened predicate: 'Нет опубликованных или запущенных процессов в этом тенанте' ('No published or running processes in this tenant') accurately reflects both branches of the new filter (published modeler defs OR live engine defs) — no stale copy left over from the pre-T-0671 published-only state. Human, plain language, consistent tone with the rest of the section (matches existing loading/error copy style). No new UI surface, dialog, or error state was introduced, so no additional review surface.
non_blocking_notes: Raw process_key display for unnamed engine processes (e.g. a human seeing 'telLinear' in the picker instead of a friendly label) is a pre-existing product-level gap (fallbackDefinitionName, T-0616), not introduced or worsened by T-0671, and explicitly out of scope per the spec. Flagging only for future backlog awareness, not blocking.
